description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam NT (Narrative)", Unicorn Gundam Unit 3 Phenex appears in master grade.

description.ja: 劇中の印象に合わせたゴールドコーティングを施し、荘厳なカラーリングを再現。
description.en: Gold coating is applied to match the impression in the play, reproducing the majestic coloring.

description.en: New parts for Armed Armor DE are included with new modeling.

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムＮＴ（ナラティブ）』版の荘厳なカラーリングを深みのあるゴールドコーティングで再現。
description.en: The majestic coloring of the "Mobile Suit Gundam NT (Narrative)" version is reproduced with a deep gold coating.

description.ja: ●　アームド・アーマーＤＥの新型パーツを新規造形で再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the new parts of Armed Armor DE with new modeling

description.ja: 尾のように伸びたスタビライザーは新型パーツを新規造形で再現。リード線を採用し、フレキシブルな表情付けが可能。
description.en: The stabilizer that extends like a tail is reproduced with new parts using new modeling. Adopts lead wire, allowing for flexible expressions.

description.ja: ●　新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属
description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decal included.

description.ja: 新規のデザインを含む水転写式デカールとホイルシールが付属。
description.en: Includes water transfer decals and foil seals including new designs.

description.ja: ●　ＭＧ準拠の可動域で、劇中のポージングを再現可能。
description.en: ● Poses from the movie can be reproduced with the MG-compliant range of motion.

description.ja: ●　２形態の変形を再現
description.en: ● Reproduces two forms of deformation.

description.ja: ユニコーンモード、デストロイモードの２つの変身を再現！
description.en: Reproduce the two transformations of unicorn mode and destroy mode!
